mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( -- Anchor Member (최상위 조건) SELECT GROUP_ID, GROUP_NM, PARENT_GROUP_ID, MHSYN,
2 AS level_val
1 AS level_val
FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO WHERE MHSYN = 'Y'
AND PARENT_GROUP_ID = 'EMART_00000000000001'
AND PARENT_GROUP_ID = #{groupId}
UNION ALL
-- Recursive Member (하위 계층 탐색) SELECT g.GROUP_ID, g.GROUP_NM, g.PARENT_GROUP_ID, g.MHSYN, c.level_val + 1 FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO g JOIN cte c ON g.PARENT_GROUP_ID = c.GROUP_ID WHERE g.MHSYN = 'Y' )
SELECT '1' AS mhsBrandlv, GROUP_NM AS mhsBrandnm, GROUP_ID AS mhsBrandcd, PARENT_GROUP_ID AS mhsParentbrandcd FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} OR GROUP_ID = (SELECT ROLE_CODE FROM TB_CENTERINFO WHERE CENTER_ID = #{centerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) UNION
SELECT CAST(level_val AS VARCHAR) AS mhsBrandlv, GROUP_NM AS mhsBrandnm, GROUP_ID AS mhsBrandcd, PARENT_GROUP_ID AS mhsParentbrandcd FROM cte
SELECT A.ROLE_CODE AS mhsBrandcd, A.CENTER_ID AS mhsCentercd, A.CENTER_NM AS mhsCenternm FROM TB_CENTERINFO A WHERE A.CENTER_ID = #{mhsCentercd}
